title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Show a compass rose and hour labels on the Session 1 sun-path app
body:
## Problem
The sun-path view in the Session 1 app has hourly dots but no hour labels, and the x axis shows numbers instead of N, E, S, W.

## Context
Students read real sun-path charts by compass direction and hour; the app should match the lesson figure. Accessibility and labelled axes are part of QUALITY.md (items 3 and 9).

## Expected outcome
Hour labels next to the dots of the chosen day and compass letters under the azimuth axis, readable in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Labels do not overlap at latitudes 0 to 35
- [ ] Screenshot in light and dark mode added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: clock time, the equation of time and real sunrise
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet; all sessions use solar time.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. Students compare the model with their watch and find the noon shadow at the 'wrong' time.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: side fins and egg-crate shading
body:
## Problem
Session 2 has only an overhang, which does little against low east and west sun.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5. West windows are the worst case in Session 3.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app where fin depth is a slider and the sunlit area combines overhang and fins, checked with the ray test.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The roadmap checkpoint is met and shown in a figure
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a window planner for any Indian city
body:
## Problem
The Target planner combines weather data, fins, a daylight map and glare and recommends a window; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus a figure like the Target for Chennai and one other city.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] For the Session 3 room in Chennai with clear sky, it reproduces the shipped best choice (north, 0.3 m overhang, WWR 0.35, about 223 kWh per year)
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
